source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC WebUI Settings > User Management and check the user list after generic prechecks/log clearing.
source_snapshot.criteria: The user list matches the configured list or a default list.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL correctly keeps a human WebUI checkpoint and read-only API comparison but uses `curl -k`, embeds Basic credentials, does not paginate, extracts only ID/username/role and cannot prove UI page/filter completeness, state freshness or protected-account handling.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with MEDIUM read-only risk correctly requires complete paginated AccountService records, every WebUI page/filter, ID/username/role/enabled/locked normalization, an approved baseline, redaction and no writes.

old_problem: The phrase `same as you set or like default` does not identify which baseline applies, and one screenshot or three-field unpaginated API response can omit accounts, filters, page state and lock/enable information. API-only evidence cannot satisfy the prescribed WebUI view, while viewing must not mutate accounts or clear the security evidence needed to investigate discrepancies.
disposition_reason: Bind the expected inventory at runtime to either the approved configured-account manifest or, only for a proven clean factory state, the vendor-documented default. Preserve actual Settings > User Management visual evidence for every page/filter, collect complete trusted Redfish account records as corroboration, normalize identity/slot/role/state and report every mismatch under a strict no-write boundary. Baseline values are Project configuration, not a remaining engineering decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 935, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, adjacent Replace-Certificate/Add-User rows and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed; row 936 and its manifest identity were independently verified.
ED-20/ED-23 require actual WebUI/visual evidence and allow API only as corroboration; therefore the source-named WebUI coverage cannot be passed by Redfish alone.

DMTF Redfish AccountService/ManagerAccount resources provide a structured authoritative read surface for account collection and supported role/state fields, but implementation fields and pagination remain target-version inputs.
ED-24's reusable default distinction prevents treating factory defaults as the configured Project baseline without proof of the applicable state.

test_case.test_name: Visually verify every WebUI User Management account against complete Redfish and approved baseline
test_case.purpose: Verify that the BMC WebUI Settings > User Management view displays the complete current account inventory across all pages and filters, and that each visible account identity/slot, role and supported enabled/locked/local-directory state matches the time-aligned complete Redfish inventory and the explicitly selected configured or factory-default baseline without changing any account or session.
required_package: Target BMC/firmware/WebUI build identity, trusted management endpoint and supported Redfish AccountService/ManagerAccount schema
Explicit baseline selector: approved configured-account manifest, or vendor-documented factory-default inventory plus evidence that the BMC is in that exact clean factory state
Complete UI-to-Redfish mapping for account/member ID, displayed username, role, enabled/locked state, account type/slot and local versus directory representation
Protected least-privilege read account, trusted TLS validation, pagination/member-expansion method and synchronized timestamps
Human/operator access to capture every User Management page, filter/sort state, total count and relevant detail view
Redaction/access-control plan for account metadata and protected recovery-account identification
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY WITH REQUIRED VISUAL EVIDENCE. Verify target and trusted TLS; preserve audit logs rather than clearing them. Select and record exactly one authoritative expected baseline. Collect the complete paginated/expanded Redfish AccountService account inventory over authenticated trusted transport without `-k`, preserving raw redacted records and count. A human/operator opens the verified BMC WebUI Settings > User Management page, records current filters/sort/page size/total, captures every page and required detail state, and refreshes once only if freshness can be proven without writes. Normalize WebUI, Redfish and expected baseline by stable account/member identity, username, role and supported state; distinguish local and directory identities and report missing, extra, stale or mismatched fields. Repeat read-only inventory for no-change evidence. Do not add, modify, enable, disable or delete accounts; do not terminate recovery sessions or clear logs.
test_case.expected_result: Every account in the selected approved baseline appears exactly once in the complete WebUI view and complete Redfish inventory with matching stable identity/slot, username, role and supported state; no unexpected account is present. Page totals, filters and pagination prove completeness, local/directory representation is correctly explained, visual evidence is time-aligned with API evidence, and protected account metadata is handled per policy. Pre/post inventory and audit evidence show no account or session configuration change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an authoritative selected baseline, complete trusted paginated Redfish records, actual visual evidence for every WebUI page/filter, a normalized one-to-one comparison of all supported identity/role/state fields, freshness/no-change proof and no write. A visible page, screenshot of one page, HTTP 200 or partial API fields cannot pass. Missing/extra/duplicate/stale account, unexplained UI/API mismatch, wrong role/state, incomplete pagination, untrusted TLS, sensitive-data exposure or any write is FAIL and stops. Missing baseline/schema/protected access is NOT READY, not Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Use a read-capable account and trusted TLS; do not use `curl -k`, expose passwords/tokens or capture unnecessary sensitive directory metadata.
Actual WebUI visual evidence is mandatory. API/DOM alone cannot replace the prescribed operator-visible User Management view.
Verify filters, sort, page size, total count and every page; stop on partial/hidden inventory or stale-target ambiguity.
Do not add, modify, disable, enable or delete accounts, force-refresh through a write, terminate protected sessions or clear security logs.
Treat configured and factory-default baselines as distinct; never infer a default solely because no Project manifest was supplied.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/firmware/WebUI identity, selected configured-or-factory baseline and authority proving it applies
Complete trusted paginated/expanded raw redacted AccountService/ManagerAccount inventory with count/hash/timestamp
Human-captured User Management screenshots for every page plus filter/sort/page-size/total/detail context
Normalized WebUI/Redfish/baseline matrix for stable ID/slot, username, role, enabled/locked/type and every discrepancy
Pre/post no-change and preserved audit evidence, protected-account handling and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On wrong target, UI/API incompleteness, stale display, schema ambiguity or sensitive-data exposure, stop, preserve/redact evidence and close the read sessions. Do not create/modify an account to force an expected list. Escalate the discrepancy for schema or Project-baseline correction.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require read-only WebUI list verification. `Configured` versus `default` is an explicit baseline selection parameter, not a competing test purpose.

blocked.reason: The WebUI, corroborating API, comparison and safety contract are defined. Account baseline, field mapping and protected access are Project readiness inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Target/WebUI/Redfish schema; configured or proven factory-default account baseline; UI/API field mapping; protected read access/TLS; visual capture and redaction policy.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ-ONLY WEBUI VISUAL TEST; NO WEBUI, API OR ACCOUNT ACTION EXECUTED

project_authority: Project account manifest or documented applicable factory-default state, target UI/schema mapping, account-data redaction policy and engineer verdict bind the expected list.
